PREREGISTRATION.cost_model: turnover_t = sum_i |w_{t,i} - w_{t-1,i}| with w_{-1} = 0; cost_t = turnover_t * COST_BPS_PER_SIDE / 1e4; net_t = gross_t - cost_t. A full monthly replacement of a gross-1 long-short is turnover 2.0, i.e. 50 bps a month or ~6%/yr, and that is the number to sanity-check against

question: How much does the model's forecast move when the NEWS changes and the calendar does not?
PIT_rule: The elasticity for a uid may enter a prediction whose decision date is on or after that headline's own `effective_at` -- E1's existing contract, unchanged. X2 adds only that BOTH the real-headline forecast and the counterfactual-substituted forecast must exist before that decision, which they trivially do: the counterfactual call needs no future information, only the already-published headline it perturbs.

full_pass_projection.reading: an OVERNIGHT-SCALE multi-night batch, not an afternoon job. --max-cells makes the first run a 300-pair sample that produces a real number the same night; the projection above is what the full pass costs in time. Dollars: $0.00, the backend is local_gguf

unmapped_reasons.MACRO: ambiguous over macro_rate_decision / macro_inflation_print / macro_labor_report / tariff_or_trade_policy / sanction
unmapped_reasons.FINANCING: ambiguous over debt_issuance_or_obligation / equity_issuance_dilution -- opposite direction priors

l2_vocabulary_mapping.reading: only the kinds whose mapping is a FUNCTION are mapped to an ID. The rest name two or more vocabulary ids with different direction priors and stay unmapped. ANALYST -- C1's largest kind, and unmappable at vocabulary v1 because the table had no analyst type -- now maps to the v2 analyst FAMILY: all three of its ids carry the same ambiguous prior, so the family commits to nothing a sub-type would contradict. Family coverage is counted separately from id coverage, because a family is coverage at the mechanism level and merging the two would overstate what the vocabulary can type

construction.why_actor_timing_is_excluded: it changes WHO or WHEN, not the event's sign or magnitude, so delta_event has no principled scale; it is kept for the flip diagnostic only
construction.escalation_convention_MEASURED: the spec proposed delta = +1 fixed and asked for it to be re-verified. Counted over all C1 rows: 4626 escalations agree with their parent's direction and 217 point the other way. A fixed +1 would be wrong for the second group, so delta = +1 in the PARENT's signed frame and disagreeing cells are dropped and counted, never forced

paired_t_true_vs_placebo.note: paired on the SAME uid: the true pair's elasticity minus the elasticity that uid's headline shows against an unrelated headline's counterfactual

SUMMARY.reading: the placebo distribution is the null, never zero: an elasticity that looks large against 0 and identical to the placebo is the arithmetic of the formula, not a property of the news

P2_dynamic_universe.note: X2 produces a FEATURE, not a book: it selects no universe and holds no position, so there is no vintage to respect here. The P7 vintage binds whichever book consumes the feature

P3_direction_flip.test: sign_flip counterfactual: sign(p_cf - p_real) == sign(delta_event), a tie counts as FAIL (spec section 3.5)

P5_full_frictions.cost_curve_id: none: X2 emits a feature and prices no book. The consuming book charges r2_trial.COST_BPS_PER_SIDE

LAP.reason_if_not_applicable: X2 reads C1's counterfactual REWRITES, which never existed before C1 wrote them, so no model can have memorised their outcome. The real headlines they perturb carry L3's own LAP; this job forecasts no dated outcome of its own

anonymisation_gap.reason: every text X2 reads is already anonymised (C1's `anon` field and its transforms), and there is no raw arm to compare against. X_anon_gap owns the gap
